name: codex-usage-widget
description: A shared Flutter desktop widget for Codex usage limits on macOS and Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Track Codex quota in a Flutter desktop widget.
interface.longDescription: Quota Bubble provides one local Flutter desktop HUD for macOS and Windows. It can stay pinned, remembers its position, hides without quitting, and displays Codex quota, balance, reset-credit, account, and subscription information.
